findings.canonical_scope: 17 players only; each has exactly one final result.
findings.source_integrity: 32 video candidates retain exact IDs and URLs. Exact-video, same-play, same-game/event, and same-origin duplicate counts are zero.
findings.acceptance_boundary: The one accepted source is the normal-speed, context-only 奈良間大己 observation; usable pure ordinal sources remain zero.
findings.conclusion_boundary: All 17 remain VIDEO_INCONCLUSIVE. No strong conclusion, video-derived numeric measure, or numeric game rating is present.
findings.construct_exclusions: Contaminated baserunning, stolen-base technique, fielding, batter-to-first transition, position priors, and edited imagery are not used as ordinal evidence.
findings.baseline_integration: The 100-player baseline player array matches the pre-video artifact; only overlays change from 25 to 42.
findings.reproducibility: All six listed input hashes match. Re-running the builder exited successfully and left all eight final output SHA-256 values unchanged.

limitation: The QA environment could not re-download four sampled YouTube URLs because of a retrieval-side error. This does not establish deletion or inaccessibility; the PASS is based on stored exact ID/URL integrity and the saved source-body review records.
